releaseNotes:
🚀 4.0 Update!

- NEW: Shader Optimization (Premium). Precompile a game to reduce stutter, and choose its GPU driver (native, ANGLE or system default) where supported.
- NEW: Texture Compression and Resizing (Premium). Shrink a game's loose texture images (PNG, JPG, WebP) to save storage and memory. Originals are backed up and can be restored anytime.
- Get Premium: Copy account details is now a separate button, Buy via Telegram only opens Telegram, and there is a new Buy via PayPal button.
